title: Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT)
narrativeSentence: To find the energy at a particular frequency, spin your signal around a circle at that frequency, and average a bunch of points along that path.

components.plainPhrase: the energy at a particular frequency
spin your signal around a circle at that frequency
components.roleIntuition: Winds the signal around the complex unit circle

subBreakdown.label: Anatomy of the Winding Factor
subBreakdown.narrativeSentence: Spin around a circle at that frequency for each step of the journey
subBreakdown.whyItExists: Euler's formula e^{iθ} = cos(θ) + i·sin(θ) allows computing rotation in 2D space through compact algebraic multiplication instead of separate sine and cosine wave summations.

parts.roleIntuition: Base of continuous growth and rotational dynamics
i turns numbers 90° into the complex plane; 2π gives a full 360° loop
How many full loops to wind per cycle

parts.plainPhrase: for each step of the journey
parts.roleIntuition: Current sample point n out of total sequence length N

components.plainPhrase: average a bunch of points along that path

subBreakdown.label: Anatomy of the Averaged Sum
subBreakdown.narrativeSentence: Accumulate all points along the path and divide by N
subBreakdown.whyItExists: If the winding frequency matches the signal, the points cluster together off-center; dividing by N computes the average center of mass.

parts.roleIntuition: Loops through every discrete time sample from 0 to N-1
Computes the true average center of gravity

adept.analogy: Passing a fruit smoothie through a prism to separate it back into the individual strawberries, bananas, and yogurt that created it.
adept.diagramConcept: Wrap the time-domain signal around a circle like a spiral. When the wrapping frequency matches the signal's rhythm, the center of mass drifts away from zero!
adept.concreteExample: Analyzing a chord played on a piano to detect that it contains notes C (261Hz), E (329Hz), and G (392Hz).
adept.plainDefinition: A mathematical prism that breaks a complex combined wave into its individual pure frequencies and their strengths.
adept.technicalDefinition: A linear transformation mapping a sequence of N complex numbers from the discrete-time domain to the discrete-frequency domain.

title: Euler's Constant e (Base of Continuous Growth)
narrativeSentence: The base for continuous growth is the unit quantity earning unit interest for unit time, compounded as fast as possible.

adept.analogy: A snowball rolling down a snowy hill. As it rolls, the newly accumulated snow immediately starts gathering even more snow without waiting for calendar days.
adept.diagramConcept: Graph compounding: 1 payout gives 2.0x, monthly gives 2.61x, daily gives 2.7145x. As frequency approaches infinity, it smoothly converges to 2.71828...
adept.concreteExample: $1 invested at 100% nominal annual return continuously compounded results in $2.71828 at year end.
adept.plainDefinition: The universal speed limit of growth when interest is instantly reinvested every microsecond.
adept.technicalDefinition: The unique real base such that the derivative of the exponential function f(x) = e^x is equal to f(x) itself.

title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention (Transformers / arXiv)
narrativeSentence: To calculate contextual relevance, compare queries against keys, scale down to prevent extreme values, convert similarity into probability weights, and blend the values accordingly.

subBreakdown.label: Anatomy of the Dot-Product Match
subBreakdown.narrativeSentence: Multiply search query vectors by transposed key catalog vectors
subBreakdown.whyItExists: Taking the dot product between high-dimensional embeddings computes cosine alignment: parallel vectors get high positive scores, orthogonal vectors get 0.

parts.roleIntuition: What each token is looking for
What each token has to offer (flipped for matrix multiplication)

components.plainPhrase: scale down to prevent extreme values

subBreakdown.label: Anatomy of the Variance Dampener
subBreakdown.narrativeSentence: Divide by the square root of projection dimension d_k
subBreakdown.whyItExists: When summing d_k random variables, their variance grows proportionally to d_k, pushing values into extreme ranges where softmax gradients vanish to zero.

parts.roleIntuition: Number of channels in each attention head
Matches the natural standard deviation growth of vector dot products

subBreakdown.label: Anatomy of the Softmax Function
subBreakdown.narrativeSentence: Exponentiate scores to ensure positivity and divide by their sum
subBreakdown.whyItExists: Softmax transforms unconstrained similarity logits into a valid probability distribution where weights sum strictly to 1.0.

parts.roleIntuition: Ensures all weights are positive and exaggerates top candidates
Divides by total so all attention weights sum to 100%

adept.analogy: A library search: your Query (what you seek) is matched against book Title/Catalog cards (Keys). The best matches determine which Book Chapters (Values) you read.
adept.diagramConcept: A matrix of words on both axes. In 'The animal didn't cross the street because it was tired', 'it' shines brightly on 'animal'.
adept.concreteExample: Resolving pronouns in sentences or paying attention to preceding code syntax in language models.
adept.plainDefinition: A routing mechanism allowing each word in a sequence to selectively absorb information from all other words based on relevance.
adept.technicalDefinition: An attention function mapping a query and a set of key-value pairs to an output computed as a weighted sum of the values, where weights are determined by scaled dot-product similarity.

title: Bayes' Theorem
narrativeSentence: The updated belief after seeing evidence is your prior belief multiplied by the evidence likelihood, diluted by total evidence occurrence.

components.plainPhrase: The updated belief after seeing evidence

components.roleIntuition: What you believed before the test

adept.analogy: A fire alarm sounding: Don't panic immediately; factor in both how often the alarm detects real fires and how often it sounds for burnt toast.
adept.diagramConcept: Two overlapping circles in a Venn diagram. P(A|B) zooms into circle B and asks what fraction of B belongs to A.
adept.concreteExample: If a rare disease affects 0.1% of people and a test is 99% accurate, a positive test still means only a ~9% chance of having the disease because false positives overwhelm true cases.
adept.plainDefinition: A mathematical rule for updating your confidence in an idea as new clues arrive.
adept.technicalDefinition: A theorem in probability theory describing the probability of an event based on prior knowledge of conditions related to the event.

title: Categorical Cross-Entropy Loss (ML / arXiv)
narrativeSentence: The penalty score sums the surprise of your model on the true answer, heavily punishing high confidence on wrong guesses.

components.plainPhrase: heavily punishing high confidence on wrong guesses
components.roleIntuition: Turns negative log into positive loss

adept.analogy: A teacher grading a quiz: saying 'I am 99% sure Paris is in Italy' gets penalised far harsher than saying 'I am unsure, 50-50'.
adept.diagramConcept: The -log(p) curve shoots up to infinity as probability approaches 0, creating a steep cliff for overconfident wrong answers.
adept.concreteExample: Training an image classifier on dogs and cats; if the image is a dog and the model says 99% cat, loss explodes to 4.6.
adept.plainDefinition: A score measuring the difference between two probability distributions: reality vs the model's beliefs.
adept.technicalDefinition: The negative log-likelihood of the true class under the model's predicted probability distribution.

title: IndexCache Multi-Layer Distillation (arXiv:2603.12201)
narrativeSentence: To train a shared attention indexer across multiple layers, average the divergence penalties between each served layer's true attention and the indexer's predicted token distribution.

components.plainPhrase: To train a shared attention indexer across multiple layers
components.roleIntuition: The composite training objective for cross-layer index reuse
Averaging across the m subsequent shared layers
Measures statistical discrepancy in token selection

components.plainPhrase: between each served layer's true attention
components.roleIntuition: The actual full attention weights of served layer ℓ+j

components.plainPhrase: and the indexer's predicted token distribution
components.roleIntuition: The top-k candidate distribution proposed by layer ℓ

adept.analogy: A school chef planning a single lunch menu (the shared indexer q) that simultaneously satisfies the diverse dietary preferences of m different classrooms (p).
adept.diagramConcept: Pulling toward the centroid: instead of pointing the indexer toward just one layer's target vector, gradients pull the indexer toward the geometric center-of-mass of all m served layers.
adept.concreteExample: Layer 4 is a Full layer whose indexer serves layers 5, 6, and 7. The loss measures how well layer 4's top-k tokens satisfy the attention needs of all 4 layers together.
adept.plainDefinition: A training loss that trains a sparse attention indexer to choose tokens that are simultaneously useful for several subsequent transformer layers.
adept.technicalDefinition: The sum of KL divergences between the true attention distributions of m layers and the indexer's output distribution, mathematically equivalent to distilling against the averaged target centroid.

title: IndexCache Centroid Distillation (arXiv:2603.12201 Eq. 2)
narrativeSentence: The single-target loss distills the full layer's indexer directly against the averaged attention centroid of all served layers.

components.roleIntuition: The student indexer network being trained

components.plainPhrase: the averaged attention centroid of all served layers
components.roleIntuition: The mean attention distribution across all served layers

adept.analogy: Instead of quizzing a student on 4 different test versions, combining the 4 versions into a single averaged master exam.
adept.diagramConcept: Averaged vector: 4 arrows pointing in similar directions are replaced by one central composite arrow.
adept.concreteExample: If layers 4, 5, 6 give token #42 attention weights 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, the centroid target is 0.5.
adept.plainDefinition: An equivalent formulation proving that multi-layer training simply points the indexer toward the average attention pattern of all served layers.
adept.technicalDefinition: The KL divergence between the arithmetic mean of target attention distributions and the predicted indexer distribution, yielding identical gradients to sum of individual KLs.

title: Single-Layer Indexer Distillation (IndexCache / arXiv:2603.12201)
narrativeSentence: The indexer distillation penalty accumulates token-by-token divergence to train the student indexer to mirror the full teacher attention pattern.

components.roleIntuition: The overall error penalizing indexer mistakes
Tallies divergence across each token position in the sequence
Measures statistical mismatch between teacher and student distributions

components.plainPhrase: to mirror the full teacher attention pattern
components.roleIntuition: The true attention distribution calculated by the full self-attention layer
The lightweight indexer network's estimate of where attention should land

adept.analogy: A speed-reader (indexer) being coached by an exhaustive proofreader (full attention) until their reading selections match perfectly.
adept.diagramConcept: Two probability curves over tokens: student curve q is pulled toward teacher curve p until overlap is maximized.
adept.concreteExample: If token #12 receives 80% true attention, the student indexer is penalized if it only predicts 20%.
adept.plainDefinition: Trains a lightweight neural indexer to predict which tokens are important by copying the full attention distribution.
adept.technicalDefinition: Token-wise KL divergence between full multi-head attention weights and predicted index probabilities for layer ℓ.

title: Gated Feed-Forward Unit (SwiGLU / ReGLU / MoE Eq. 4)
normalizedLatex: X_{\text{out}} = \left(\sigma(X_{\text{in}} W_{\text{gate}} + b_{\text{gate}}) \odot \text{ReLU}(X_{\text{in}} W_{\text{up}} + b_{\text{up}})\right) W_{\text{down}}
colorizedLatex: {\color{#8B5CF6} X_{\text{out}}} = \left({\color{#3B82F6} \sigma(\cdot)}{\color{#10B981} (X_{\text{in}} W_{\text{gate}} + b_{\text{gate}})} {\color{#EF4444} \odot} {\color{#F59E0B} \text{ReLU}(\cdot)}{\color{#EC4899} (X_{\text{in}} W_{\text{up}} + b_{\text{up}})}\right) {\color{#8B5CF6} W_{\text{down}}}
narrativeSentence: The output token features dynamically gate feature flow with a linear controller, element-wise filtering the non-linear candidate activations before projecting back down.

components.roleIntuition: Updated hidden states sent to the residual stream
Squashes gate values into [0, 1] to decide feature pass-through
Computes which feature channels need to be admitted or suppressed

subBreakdown.label: Anatomy of the Linear Gate
subBreakdown.whyItExists: Standard MLPs process all activations uniformly. A separate gating projection creates a dynamic valve controlled by the input itself.

parts.roleIntuition: Learned parameters that extract gating criteria from input embeddings
Baseline default openness for each feature channel

components.roleIntuition: Multiplies gate probabilities element-by-element with candidate features
Zeroes negative proposal signals to inject expressive non-linearity
Expands input into higher-dimensional hidden candidate space
Compresses gated features back into the standard residual stream dimension

adept.analogy: A bouncer (gate) standing beside a chef (up-projection): the chef cooks up full dishes of candidate flavors, and the bouncer checks the guest list to decide exactly which dishes make it onto the dining table.
adept.diagramConcept: Dual parallel branches: input splits into Gate and Value branches. The Gate produces 0-to-1 dials that pointwise scale the Value branch before merging.
adept.concreteExample: In LLaMA 3 and MoE architectures, SwiGLU / ReGLU replaces standard FFNs, significantly reducing perplexity because irrelevant features can be shut off completely (multiplied by ~0).
adept.plainDefinition: A neural network layer that proposes new candidate thoughts with one branch while another branch acts as a dimmer switch controlling which thoughts actually pass through.
adept.technicalDefinition: A bilinear gated MLP unit where the hidden state is computed as the Hadamard product of a linear gate activation and a non-linear candidate feature projection, followed by a linear down-projection.
